## v1.10.0 — 2026-03-21

Version 1.10.0 introduces production launch hardening with tier-based access controls, usage metering, comprehensive testing infrastructure, and security improvements. This release includes new paid tier distribution through @cullit/licensed package, enhanced CI/CD pipelines with Playwright testing, and various bug fixes for pricing, packaging, and site accuracy.

### ✨ Features

- Added private @cullit/licensed package for paid tier distribution and access control
- Implemented usage metering in CLI that reports after successful generate operations
- Added comprehensive Playwright end-to-end testing for dashboard tier gating
- Implemented tier workflow matrix coverage for free/pro/team/enterprise API testing
- Added production launch hardening for gates 7-12 with enhanced readiness checks
- Added system flow diagrams and enforced documentation sync policy for architecture docs

### 🔧 Improvements

- Upgraded ESLint from 8.57.1 to 10.0.3
- Enhanced CI pipeline with Playwright browser installation and pnpm configuration in Docker
- Hardened readiness guards and local pre-push gate validation
- Aligned pricing navbar branding with site-wide styling standards
- Synchronized legal text checks with current terms wording

### 🐛 Bug Fixes

- Fixed audit issues including security vulnerabilities, packaging problems, and pricing accuracy
- Resolved CI lint failure in markdown formatter test
- Fixed npm package messaging alignment with actual distribution model and normalized navigation CTA CSS
- Migrated lint configuration for ESLint 10 compatibility
- Enforced lockfile consistency and fixed CI installation issues

### 🧹 Chores

- Reduced lint warnings below launch threshold through comprehensive code cleanup
- Added type integration boundaries and improved codebase typing
- Renamed cullit-docs to cullit-ea and added EA documentation audit workflow
- Removed internal architecture docs from public repository surface

### Contributors

@mttaylor, @dependabot[bot]
